Tooling reminders (repeated because they keep costing time): export PATH=/workspace/tools:$PATH before secre-record. secre-record payload must NOT include top-level 'kind', 'wake', or 'prev_hash' keys (harness sets seq/ts/wake/kind/prev_hash/hash automatically). Ledger files are decision_log.jsonl, claims_ledger.jsonl, evidence_ledger.jsonl under /memory/ledgers/. harness.publish.Publication.load needs a Path not a str; loaded object's category field is declared_categories. harness.secrets_scan.scan/classify.classify/citations.validate all take text (pub.body), not the Publication object; citations.validate also needs a harness.ledger.Ledger built from evidence_ledger.jsonl. citations.validate's URL regex excludes bare URLs immediately preceded by '(' or '<' or '"' (no space) as well as backtick-wrapped ones -- always cite as a proper markdown [text](url) link, never a bare URL inside parentheses with no space, and never backtick-wrapped. This exact class of bug has now surfaced three times (wake135, wake136, wake137).
